_comment: You do not normally need this file — click Connect on the node and approve it in the browser, and the token is written to ComfyUI/user/framethrower/config.json for you. This example is for headless installs. Copy it there (or next to this file, which still takes precedence), mode 600. Environment variables FT_API_TOKEN / FT_API_URL / FAL_KEY override anything here.
